Who we call on

Electrical expertise for the people responsible for uptime.

CT Electrical Sales supports organizations that design, build, operate and maintain critical electrical systems across the Rocky Mountain region.

Markets served

Different facilities. The same need for reliable power.

We connect technical requirements with specialized manufacturers, practical product selection and responsive territory support.

HC

Hospitals & healthcare

Critical-power, monitoring, UPS, bypass, thermal monitoring and distribution solutions for facilities where electrical reliability directly supports patient care.

DC

Data centers

Power visibility, metering, UPS infrastructure, harmonic mitigation, monitoring and reliability solutions for high-density, uptime-driven environments.

MF

Manufacturing

Industrial power distribution, controls, transformers, power quality, cable management and modernization support for continuous operations.

OE

OEMs

Component selection and manufacturer coordination for original equipment builders that need dependable electrical products, repeatability and application support.

EO

Electrical OEMs

Switchboard, panel, enclosure and equipment manufacturers supported with breakers, controls, transformers, wire, metering and related components.

EC

Electrical contractors

Product guidance, substitutions, availability coordination and manufacturer access for commercial and industrial electrical projects.

EE

Engineers & consultants

Specification assistance, product comparisons and technical resources for electrical system design and modernization.

ED

Electrical distributors

Channel-focused sales support that helps distributor teams pursue opportunities, clarify applications and serve their customers effectively.

CI

Commercial & institutional

Electrical solutions for campuses, public facilities, offices, hospitality, education and other complex building environments.
